description: A Claude Code cursor picker drawn inside a │ frame, the highlight on the second row. classify() reads `selected` off the highlighted row, stripping the frame's closing bar only because the row opens with one: an unframed row's trailing bar is part of its label (tests/test_cursor_select.py proves that half). This sample guards that the framed case still grounds `selected` (1) and the arrow keymap. Fictional screen (tmux-rc, 2026-10-12).
